notes: cics-crucible condition-handling / hc-abend-link (Apache-2.0 corpus, owner OK 2026-10-31 for the ladder, #6072): HANDLE CONDITION / HANDLE ABEND across LINK levels, abend exits at a higher level, PUSH and POP HANDLE. Scenarios restate the crucible's terminal steps; the oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub, not the crucible's hand-written logs.

scenarios.name: sub-resp
scenarios.why: HCSUB tests QIDERR with RESP; back in HCMAIN the QIDERR handler is in force again

scenarios.name: sub-unhandled
scenarios.why: HCSUB raises QIDERR without RESP: HCMAIN's handler is not inherited, the task abends AEYH in HCSUB, and HCMAIN's HANDLE ABEND LABEL exit (one level up) gets control

scenarios.name: sub-own-exit
scenarios.why: HCSUB sets its own abend exit, ABENDs with HCX1, recovers in the exit and RETURNs normally to HCMAIN

scenarios.name: push-pop
scenarios.why: PUSH HANDLE then POP HANDLE: the QIDERR handler is back after the POP

scenarios.name: pushed-abend
scenarios.why: QIDERR while handlers are PUSHed: neither the QIDERR handler nor the HANDLE ABEND exit is in effect, so the task terminates with AEYH
